integrity: The supplied proof covers every indicated finite parameter and the asymptotic crossover; finite checks corroborate but do not replace it. No claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to iid uniform map images and cycle-weighted covariances; macroscopic directed cycles are rare. Historical equivalence to older multivariate generating functions remains a residual originality risk. Independent validation has not occurred.
title: Exact cycle–indegree covariance phases in uniform random mappings
